# Tool logos

Drawn into the README artwork by `theme.py` (the toolbox, the link buttons, and the glyphs on the stat cards). Each logo belongs to its owner and is used here only to name the tool.

- Most files: the [Iconify `logos` set](https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos) (CC0), fetched from `https://api.iconify.design/logos/<name>.svg`.
- `cursor.svg`: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/) 16.37.0 (CC0).
- `instagram.svg`: [Skill Icons](https://github.com/tandpfun/skill-icons) (MIT), from Iconify.
- `spline.png`: Spline's own logo from spline.design, resized to 64 px (no SVG version exists).
- `behance.svg`: Simple Icons 16.37.0 (CC0).
- `warp.svg`: Simple Icons 16.37.0 (CC0), with its fill set to black so `theme.py` recolours it for the dark theme.
- `clickup.svg`: the Iconify `logos` set's `clickup-icon` (CC0).
- `tripo.svg`: [theSVG](https://github.com/glincker/thesvg) (MIT), the `thesvg-color` version from Iconify.
- `ui/`: [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/) glyphs (ISC), from `https://api.iconify.design/lucide/<name>.svg`.
